name: security-cam
title: Security Cam
description: A scene as surveillance footage: luma and colour squeezed into blocks, colour drained, blacks crushed and a slow brightness pump with noise crawling in the shadows. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video.
useWhen: A beat should play as surveillance footage: a cold open or a 'meanwhile, in production' aside that reads as captured rather than presented.
The story is about a feed degrading: drive compression up and the picture falls apart into blocks.
avoidWhen: The story is the glass a shot was taken through: use camera-lens.
The story is a tube being watched: use crt-screen.
You want analog wear that smears colour sideways: use vhs-filter.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Small heading above the list in the sample scene.

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: Rows of the list as name | status, separated by semicolons (up to 5).
variables.default: intro-scene.mp4 | Done; feature-tour.mp4 | Rendering; pricing-outro.mp4 | Queued

variables.label: Compression
variables.description: How hard luma and colour collapse into blocks.

variables.label: Block size
variables.description: Size of one macroblock. Pixel sizes are for a 1280×720 frame and scale with the frame.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: 0 shows the scene, 1 the full recorder look.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Blocks are coarse; 0.75 matches 1 in the stills.
